root_cause: Tags (hashtags) were never stored as a field: social_posts and bg_post_kenmerken had no tag column, only 4 of 97 LinkedIn texts contained a hashtag and 0 contained a mention. The original LinkedIn loop could therefore never test tags as its single variable and no tag claim could be learned.
prevention_rules: A variable that should be learned from must be captured per post before it is tested; unknown stays NULL, never an assumed zero.
Tags are tested only through the existing single-variable LinkedIn loop (one owner, one variable per post); never as a second competing creative experiment.
Tag instructions never ask readers to tag, like or share (engagement-bait rule) and never claim a winner from a before/after without control.
Backfill links text to a post only on a unique channel-day match with a published artifact; ambiguous days stay unknown and are counted, not guessed.
prevention_rule: Capture a variable per post before testing it; only the existing loop tests it, one variable at a time, unknown stays NULL.
